items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: I saw Ed in the trombone section and Jim Buffington, a French horn player was there.

ctx.x: Well listen, how did your name come up when they started to put the Sauter-Finegan band together?

They were auditioning musicians in New York when they started the band, and they said, “Does anybody know of any oboe doublers?” And this one trombone player said, “Yeah I know a guy up in Rochester.” Eddie Irwin, Eddie played in the New York Philharmonic. He says, “This guy doubles, he’s a good doubler.” He says, “I don’t call him a doubler, he plays good oboe.” So I didn’t know it was through Ed that I got the audition until I got to the rehearsal, to the audition itself, which was a combination…
